proposals.synthetic_case_summary: R1-1 4-unit multiplex, clean packet, all Stage 1 docs including neighbour-notification. ZDB-R1-1-UNITS evidence map includes neighbour-notification as a required field. No numeric gaps.
proposals.rationale: Teaches the happy-path: neighbour-notification is always a required evidence key for ZDB-R1-1-UNITS, regardless of other case characteristics.

proposals.synthetic_case_summary: R1-1 4-unit multiplex, neighbour-notification present, parking gap (2 of 4 spaces). ZDB-R1-1-UNITS evidence includes neighbour-notification alongside the parking gap.
proposals.rationale: Teaches that neighbour-notification membership in ZDB-R1-1-UNITS evidence is independent of unrelated numeric gaps.

proposals.synthetic_case_summary: R1-1 3-unit multiplex, neighbour-notification absent from submitted docs. ZDB-R1-1-UNITS evidence still lists neighbour-notification. Missing document surfaces in incomplete_reasons.
proposals.rationale: Teaches the critical separation: neighbour-notification is always a required evidence field in ZDB-R1-1-UNITS evidence_fields_by_bylaw. Document absence goes into incomplete_reasons, not into evidence omission.

rationale: Triage round-001 shows neighbour-notification missing from ZDB-R1-1-UNITS evidence in 17 of 18 gold cases (M5 = 0.722). Three synthetic rows each isolate one scenario: clean packet, gap-present packet, and missing-document packet. All three confirm that neighbour-notification is a permanent required field for ZDB-R1-1-UNITS regardless of submission state.
